decisions.reason: The IMU module is a core building block that is cheap to stock, and a growing firm with slack has no shortfall that would push it to search for other uses of these resources.
The industrial AC voltage input module extends the industrial measurement line toward the users the firm targets and was presented prominently, so it likely meets aspirations.
The four-channel solid-state relay sits close to the established offer, costs little to carry, and fits the automation use cases on the new platform.
The RGB LED control module is a recent, low-cost addition to the modular system, and with slack available it can be carried while its results build.
Remote access for wallboxes supports the strategic expansion of the charging and energy-management line, so the firm has strong reason to keep investing in it.
